insight: Raised a $6M seed led by Blumberg Capital (Oct 2025); founded by Unit 8200 / SentinelOne veterans, with Cloudflare and Groq as partners.
name: Anchor Browser
tagline: Cloud browser infrastructure for AI agents.
description: Anchor Browser runs fully managed, stealth Chromium instances in the cloud so AI agents can navigate websites, log in, fill forms, and extract data like a human would. It ships built-in authentication (OmniConnect), an enterprise VPN, a Web Action Cache for deterministic workflows, and scales to many parallel sessions. The Chromium fork is verified by Cloudflare's Web-Bot-Auth to survive bot detection.

modelSupport.notes: Browser infrastructure; bring your own inference provider and agent framework.

edge: Cloudflare-verified stealth Chromium with built-in auth and VPN, built to survive bot detection that blocks generic headless browsers.
